summary: David Lunde, 29, of Durango drove up La Plata Canyon to the Madden Peak trail Oct 1, 2022 to run/hike the 'La Plata Enchilada' traverse; didn't show for work that night, reported missing the next day; intense search in rain-turned-snow found no trace.
location: Madden Peak trailhead, La Plata Canyon, La Plata County
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue
notes: No trace ever found; outcome fatality (presumed; never located).
